# DIRECTV Community Forums

> > A user-driven support and discussion community for DIRECTV satellite TV, streaming services, and connected devices across multiple platforms.

DIRECTV Community Forums is an active peer-to-peer and moderator-supported forum where users troubleshoot issues, share feature requests, and discuss DIRECTV products including satellite TV, DIRECTV Stream, and apps on Roku, Fire TV, LG SmartTV, and other devices. The community is moderated by DIRECTV support staff and serves as a knowledge base for common problems and feature suggestions.

## Key Topics

- DIRECTV
- DIRECTV Stream
- Streaming devices
- Roku
- Amazon Fire TV
- DVR and recordings
- Troubleshooting
- Feature requests
- Community support
- DIRECTVhelp
- Satellite TV
- User discussions
- How-to guides
- Product guides
- LG SmartTV

## Community Essentials

- [DIRECTV Community Forums](https://forums.directv.com): DIRECTV Community Forums homepage for tech support and user discussions

- [Community How-To](https://forums.directv.com/page/Community-How-To): How-to guide for navigating DIRECTV Community Forums features

- [Problem with fast forwarding](https://forums.directv.com/conversations/watching-streaming/problem-with-fast-forwarding/6998a987880e2f00ee2793ed): Troubleshooting fast-forward bug on DIRECTV Roku app
- [Fast Forward Issue](https://forums.directv.com/conversations/watching-streaming/fast-forward-issue/69bb2e2184696016671f5626): DVR playback comparison between DIRECTV and Xfinity services
- [LIBRARY of recordings does NOT show up on Windows 11 computer](https://forums.directv.com/conversations/watching-streaming/library-of-recordings-does-not-show-up-on-windows-11-computer/69bd477a6105fd68f7dcba80): Troubleshooting library display issue on Windows 11 for DIRECTV
- [Manual padding/start/end times](https://forums.directv.com/conversations/watching-streaming/manual-paddingstartend-times/69b0f485d0cb2a7543d70ab6): Feature request for manual DVR padding in DIRECTV streaming
